title: Cloning BRD4 long isoform into overexpression vectors for stable overexpression of BRD4-L in mammalian cells
protocol: Design PCR primers containing sequences of BRD4-L cDNA and overexpression vector LentiV_Blast based on Reference Sequence NM_058243.3.
Analyze full sequence of prospective primers for potential hairpin formation and self-annealing using OligoCalc website.
Avoid primer pairs predicted to form hairpin or self-annealing structures.
Accept forward and reverse primer pairs with melting temperature differences smaller than 5°C.
Allow primers that permit self-annealing without forming hairpins due to limited options.
Download the Reference Sequence for Homo sapiens bromodomain containing 4 (BRD4), transcript variant long, mRNA from the NCBI’s website using GenBank.
Download the sequence for LentiV_Blast from Addgene’s website.
Identify in the sequence of LentiV_Blast the point of insertion of the gene to be overexpressed by locating the BamHI restriction enzyme site (GGATCC).
Assemble prospective forward and reverse PCR primers containing 18–20 bases complimentary to the gene of interest plus 15 bases corresponding to the vector.
Ensure that the forward primer includes the start codon (ATG) and the reverse primer includes one of the three stop codons (TAA, TAG or TGA).
Verify potential hairpin formation and self-annealing of the full sequence of the prospective primers using OligoCalc website.
Check that the difference in melting temperature between forward and reverse primers is smaller than 5°C.
Grow bacteria for 16 hours in LB medium containing 100 μg/mL of ampicillin.
Extract circular plasmids from bacteria using QIAGEN’s CompactPrep Plasmid Maxi Kit.
Linearize the circular plasmid with restriction enzyme BamHI.
Collect bacteria from the agar stab using a disposable sterile pipette tip.
Add the bacteria to a 500 mL flask containing 100 mL of 2.5% LB medium and 100 μg/mL of ampicillin by touching the pipette tip inside the flask.
Cover the 500 mL flask with aluminum foil.
Incubate the flask at 37°C for 16 hours on a benchtop shaker set to 240 rpm.
Perform plasmid purification using the CompactPrep Plasmid Maxi Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute the purified plasmid in 70 μL of Buffer EB.
Measure the concentration of the eluted plasmid with a spectrophotometer.
Adjust the final concentration of the plasmid to 1 μg/μL.
Digest 4 μg of LentiV_Blast with BamHI at 37°C for 16 hours using a thermocycler.
Run the digestion product in 0.8% agarose gel for 35-40 minutes using a voltage of 110 V.
Add 10 μL of DNA ladder to each side of the gel.
Remove the digested plasmid from the agarose gel using the QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit protocol.
Elute the linearized vector in 30 μL of UltraPure™ water.
Measure the linearized vector’s concentration with spectrophotometer.
Adjust the final concentration of the linearized vector to 25 ng/μL if possible.
Incubate the template in betaine for 16 hours.
Incubate the DNA template with 0.5 M betaine for 16 hours before performing PCR reaction.
Use Phusion™ G-C Buffer instead of Phusion™ HF Buffer.
Use initial denaturation time of 3 min.
Adjust annealing temperature to 61.6°C for optimal results with specific primers.
Perform a gradient experiment around the calculated mid-point temperature for ideal annealing.
Test temperatures ranging from approximately 10°C higher to 10°C lower than the calculated mid-point.
Combine DNA template with 5 M betaine and UltraPure™ water in a PCR tube.
Vortex the mixture and spin down.
Incubate the tube at 4°C for 16 h.
Add PCR reagents to the tube containing the incubated template.
Ensure polymerase is added last to the reaction mix.
Vortex the final mix and spin down.
Conduct PCR using thermocycler according to cycling conditions provided.
Run PCR product on a 0.8% agarose gel for 35-40 min at 110 V.
Remove the PCR product from the agarose gel using the QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Elute the PCR product in 30 μL of UltraPure™ water.
Measure the concentration of the PCR product with a spectrophotometer.
Adjust the concentration of the BRD4-L insert to be within the desired range (20–200 ng/μL).
Adjust the concentration of the LentiV_Blast linearized vector to be within the range of 10–100 ng/μL.
Perform Cold Fusion™ cloning according to the manufacturer’s protocol, using a BRD4-L insert:LentiV_Blast linearized vector ratio of 3:2 molar ratio.
Add 250 μL pre-warmed SOC Medium and incubate the tube at 37°C with shaking at 1,200 rpm for 1 hour.
Pre-warm a culture plate containing ampicillin in a 37°C incubator for 1 hour.
Spread the entire volume of the reaction (260 μL) onto the pre-warmed culture plate containing ampicillin.
Incubate the plate with Cold Fusion™ competent cells spread in 37°C for 16–20 hours.
Wrap the plates in plastic film and place them in 4°C until ready to perform miniprep.
Perform vector linearization, PCR amplification, and Cold Fusion™ cloning.
Conduct miniprep for isolated plasmid DNA.
Screen clones using restriction enzyme combination EcoRI and MluI.
Verify specific band sizes of 8,229 bp and 2,672 bp on agarose gel electrophoresis.
Add 2 mL of 2.5% LB Media with 100 μg/mL ampicillin to 15 mL polypropylene tubes.
Incubate the tubes for 16 hours in a benchtop shaker at 36°C set at 240 rpm.
Perform miniprep using the QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit, following the manufacturer's protocol.
Elute the plasmid in 30 μL of EB buffer.
Measure the plasmid concentration with a spectrophotometer.
Digest 500 ng of LentiV_Blast-BRD4-L with EcoRI and MluI at 37°C for 3 hours.
Run the digestion product in a 0.8% agarose gel using 100 V for 35–40 minutes.
Add betaine to the LentiV_Blast-BRD4-L plasmid to a concentration of 0.1 M before Sanger DNA sequencing.
Send the plasmid candidates for sequencing to ensure the correct sequence for BRD4-L has been cloned into LentiV_Blast.
Transform DH5-alpha competent E. coli with the LentiV_Blast-BRD4-L plasmid.
Incubate in ice for 30 minutes after transformation.
Transfer the mixture to a water bath at 42°C for exactly 30 seconds.
Cool down the solution immediately by immersing it in ice for 2 minutes.
Add 250 μL of pre-warmed SOC Medium to the cooled mixture.
Incubate the tube at 37°C, shaking at a speed of 1200 rpm, for 1 hour.
Spread 50 μL of the solution containing competent E. coli onto a pre-warmed agarose/ampicillin plate.
Incubate the agarose/ampicillin plate with the DH5-alpha cell spread for 16 hours at 37°C.
Wrap the plates in plastic film and place them in 4°C until ready to perform maxiprep.
Pick one of the bacterial colonies on the agarose/ampicillin plate using a disposable, sterile pipette tip.
Drop the pipette tip into a 500 mL flask containing 100 mL of 2.5% LB medium with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the 500 mL flask for 16 hours on a benchtop shaker at 36°C, set to shake at 1 g.
Perform bacterial growth for plasmid isolation via maxiprep at 36°C.
Isolate the plasmid using the CompactPrep Plasmid Maxi Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute the plasmid in 70 μL of EB buffer.
Measure the plasmid concentration with a spectrophotometer.
Send the plasmid for sequencing to ensure the correct sequence for BRD4-L has been cloned into LentiV_Blast.
Add 0.1 M Betaine to the LentiV_Blast-BRD4-L plasmid before Sanger DNA sequencing.
